Notes

Dear Giles Hugo,

Here’s the notes from your call with Alex - GSF Gliding Systems 01691 770303 on 25 September 2026 at 10:29:

Giles Hugo discussed current product costs and potential price reductions with Alex from GSF Gliding Systems to improve profitability before launching a new product. They plan to negotiate pricing adjustments with the accounts team on Monday.

Recap

  • Giles Hugo reviewed his last two orders with Alex, noting that initial quotes were around 300 pounds per unit, but recent costs have increased to approximately 635 pounds per unit due to material price rises.
  • Giles Hugo indicated that the product has not yet been launched but has already sold 4 units and has promising inquiries, with an estimated market size of about 400 units for similar products.
  • Alex confirmed that material costs increased slightly since February, from 650 pounds to 653 pounds per unit, and agreed to explore options to reduce costs.
  • Giles Hugo requested that Alex attempt to negotiate a better price or a credit with the accounts team, which Alex plans to do on Monday, including possibly adjusting shipping costs or offering a credit.
  • Both parties agreed that Alex would involve the accounts team and coordinate with Alex from GSF Gliding Systems to seek approval for any discounts or cost adjustments, with follow-up expected on Monday.

Tasks

  • Alex from GSF Gliding Systems will speak to the accounts team on Monday to negotiate potential price reductions or credits for Giles Hugo's orders.
  • Alex will email Giles Hugo after discussing with the accounts team to confirm any approved adjustments.
